visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand wearing a thin plastic glove holds a thick black card using silver metal tweezers. The top of the card features the gold embossed logo '炎上 BURN'. The setting is a brightly lit indoor environment with a dark background. (2) The camera zooms in on the bottom section of the card, showing a line of small white text. The lighting remains bright, clearly illuminating the texture of the black paper. (3) The hand positions the card over a black gas stove burner in a kitchen. The burner is initially unlit. The countertop is a light marble-like material. (4) The gas stove is ignited, producing a blue and orange flame. The hand brings the card closer to the fire. Smoke begins to rise from the surface of the card as it heats. (5) As the heat interacts with the card, a color image of a man's face (Brian Tseng) wearing a dark shirt gradually emerges within an ornate picture frame. The background of the reveal image is reddish and dramatic. (6) The card catches fire at the bottom edge, with orange flames spreading quickly across the paper. Thick white smoke billows upward from the charred edges as the man's face becomes fully visible. (7) The video transitions to a digital graphic of the full promotional poster. The man is centered in a frame surrounded by animated fire effects. Details of the show, including dates and venues, are visible on the right side.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是炎上的邀請函. [Logo]: 炎上 BURN. (2) [Subtitle]: 它看起來漆黑極了. (3) [Subtitle]: 上面寫. (4) [Subtitle]: 要放置火上20公分處火烤. [Slogan]: 請將卡片放置火上20公分處火烤，解鎖主秀秘密訊息. (5) [Subtitle]: ...好像沒什麼反應. (6) [Subtitle]: 近一點好了. (7) [Subtitle]: 出現了. (8) [Subtitle]: 是曾博... (9) [Subtitle]: 啊燒過頭了. (10) [Slogan]: 炎上 BURN 曾博恩 台北流行音樂中心 炎亞綸 7.4.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Brian Tseng, appearing on the card, has short dark hair and is wearing a dark, collared shirt with Western-style embroidery.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic kitchen with a black gas stove and a light-colored stone countertop. The final scene is a digital graphic background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in a calm, informative tone, explaining the mysterious invitation card. The background environment is relatively quiet with minimal room tone. (2) As the narration continues at a steady pace, a sharp mechanical clicking sound occurs twice as the gas burner is ignited. This is immediately followed by a low-frequency, continuous whooshing sound representing the gas flame. (3) The speaker's pitch rises slightly, indicating curiosity as he describes the card's lack of reaction. The background fire noise remains steady. A subtle rustling sound of plastic indicates movement of the hand. (4) As the card begins to smoke, the narrator's arousal level increases, becoming more animated and louder. A distinct crackling sound of paper burning is layered into the mix, growing in intensity as the visual fire spreads. (5) A sudden, loud dramatic orchestral stinger with heavy percussion and synthesizers bursts in. The speaker shouts the name '炎上! 曾博恩!' with high energy and authority. The sound of a roaring blaze dominates the final seconds before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative marketing reveal for the comedy roast show 'BURN' (炎上) featuring Brian Tseng. It uses a high-concept 'heat-revealed' physical invitation to build intrigue and demonstrate the show's theme of 'being roasted' or 'on fire'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is a promotional teaser for the live event '炎上 BURN' featuring Brian Tseng, showing the event logo, date, and main star.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The use of a thermochromic or heat-sensitive card as a physical prop creates a strong sensory hook for the audience.
